title: Can Quantum Layers offer Performance and Security Advantages in Vision-Language Models?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As quantum computing moves from the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era toward early fault-tolerant quantum computing (EFTQC), quantum-enhanced AI is shifting from a conceptual idea to experimental research. Quantum components are expected to extend the capabilities of existing AI systems, yet it remains unclear how such components will help within large multimodal models. In this study, we try to answer that question for vision-language models (VLMs) using classically simulated quantum layers. With LLaVA-OneVision as the backbone, we evaluate 4- and 8-qubit basic-ring and strongly entangling circuits at four insertion and four replacement locations. Insertion adds quantum layers to the classical model, while replacement substitutes them for classical components. translated_title: 量子层能否为视觉-语言模型带来性能与安全优势？
translated_abstract: 随着量子计算从含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）时代迈向早期容错量子计算（EFTQC），量子增强AI正从一个概念性想法转变为实验性研究。量子组件有望扩展现有AI系统的能力，然而此类组件将如何在大规模多模态模型中发挥作用仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们尝试利用经典模拟的量子层，针对视觉-语言模型（VLMs）回答这一问题。以LLaVA-OneVision为骨干网络，我们在四个插入位置和四个替换位置上评估了4量子比特和8量子比特的基本环形线路与强纠缠线路。插入方式是将量子层添加到经典模型中，而替换方式则是用量子层取代经典组件。在相同的实验设置下，我们比较了经典模型与量子-经典混合模型之间的性能与计算成本。在Visual Spatial Reasoning数据集上，插入……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究以LLaVA-OneVision为骨干，通过在多个位置插入或替换4/8量子比特的模拟量子线路，系统比较了量子-经典混合视觉-语言模型与纯经典模型在性能、安全性及计算成本上的差异，以探究量子层在大规模多模态模型中的实际价值。
en_tdlr: This study systematically investigates whether simulated quantum layers (4- and 8-qubit basic-ring and strongly entangling circuits), inserted into or replacing components of LLaVA-OneVision-based vision-language models, can offer performance and security advantages over purely classical models at comparable computational cost.
